Title: General availability: AKS support for Kubernetes 1.21

Body.Content:
AKS support for Kubernetes release 1.21 is now generally available. Kubernetes 1.21 delivers a total of 50 enhancements in various stages of maturity, including 19 completely new capabilities. This release includes capabilities such as a new memory manager and a more flexible scheduler.

Learn more.
